questions.prompt: Anda menulis kepada manajer hotel yang belum pernah Anda temui. Salam pembuka yang paling tepat adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Penerima tidak dikenal namanya, jadi register formal: 'Dear Sir or Madam,'. 'Hi there' dan 'Hey manager' terlalu santai.

questions.prompt: Surat dibuka dengan 'Dear Mr Patel,'. Penutup yang paling tepat adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Aturan Inggris Britania: nama penerima diketahui -> 'Yours sincerely,'. 'Cheers' dan 'Love' terlalu informal untuk atasan atau kenalan formal.

questions.prompt: Surat dibuka dengan 'Dear Sir or Madam,'. Penutup yang paling tepat adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Penerima tanpa nama -> 'Yours faithfully,'. Pasangan salam-penutup harus konsisten.

questions.prompt: Anda menulis surat kepada teman dekat. Penutup yang paling wajar adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Surat informal cocok dengan 'Best wishes,', 'Take care,' atau 'All the best,'. Pilihan lain terlalu kaku.

questions.prompt: Kalimat mana yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan tujuan surat keluhan formal?
questions.explanation_id: Pembuka formal: 'I am writing to + verba'. Pilihan lain memakai bahasa lisan/slang.
options: I'm writing 'cause I want to complain.
I am writing to complain about the service I received.
Just wanted to moan about your shop.
So, about your service, it was bad.
correct_answers: I am writing to complain about the service I received.

questions.prompt: Permintaan pengembalian uang yang paling sopan dalam surat formal adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Permintaan sopan memakai 'I would be grateful if you could...' atau 'Could you please...'. Bentuk perintah langsung terdengar kasar.
options: Give me my money back now.
I would be grateful if you could refund my money.
correct_answers: I would be grateful if you could refund my money.

questions.prompt: Anda mengundang teman dekat makan malam. Kalimat mana yang paling alami?
questions.explanation_id: Undangan untuk teman memakai bahasa akrab ('Do you fancy...?', 'Would you like to...?'). Tiga pilihan lain terlalu resmi.
options: I would like to extend an invitation for you to attend.
Do you fancy coming over for dinner on Saturday?
You are cordially requested to attend.
correct_answers: Do you fancy coming over for dinner on Saturday?

questions.prompt: Dalam surat kepada manajer bank, kalimat mana yang TIDAK pantas karena terlalu santai?
questions.explanation_id: 'Thanks a bunch, talk soon!' adalah bahasa percakapan antarteman. Tiga lainnya adalah frasa surat formal baku.
options: I would like to enquire about opening an account.
I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.prompt: Pada surat formal, bentuk mana yang lebih tepat?
questions.explanation_id: Surat formal menghindari kontraksi (can't, don't) dan kalimat tanpa subjek. 'I cannot' lebih tepat; 'ain't' tidak baku.
options: I ain't going to the meeting.

questions.prompt: Anda terlambat membayar sewa dan menulis kepada pemilik rumah yang Anda kenal (semi-formal). Pilihan terbaik adalah...
questions.explanation_id: Semi-formal ke pemilik rumah: sopan dan jelas ('I apologise for...'). Ungkapan 'my bad', 'whoops', 'mate' terlalu santai.
options: Sorry about the late rent, my bad.
I apologise for the delay in paying the rent.
correct_answers: I apologise for the delay in paying the rent.

questions.prompt: Kalimat penutup yang paling pantas untuk surat formal adalah...
questions.explanation_id: 'I look forward to hearing from you...' adalah penutup baku. Tiga lainnya santai atau terlalu pendek.
options: I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
correct_answers: I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.

questions.prompt: Cara paling tepat membuka surat permintaan informasi kepada sebuah perusahaan adalah...
questions.explanation_id: 'I am writing to enquire about + hal' adalah pola formal baku (enquire/inquire sama-sama benar).
options: I am writing to enquire about your evening courses.
I wanna know about your courses.
correct_answers: I am writing to enquire about your evening courses.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi penutup surat:
'Dear Sir or Madam, ... I look forward to your reply.
Yours _______,'
questions.explanation_id: Salam 'Dear Sir or Madam,' dipasangkan dengan penutup 'Yours faithfully,'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi kalimat pembuka surat formal:
'I am writing to _______ about the damaged package that I received yesterday.'
questions.explanation_id: Konteks 'damaged package' menuntut tujuan keluhan: 'I am writing to complain about...'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang SALAH secara tata bahasa:
questions.explanation_id: Setelah 'will not' kata kerja berbentuk dasar: 'will not attend', bukan 'attending'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang SALAH secara tata bahasa:
questions.explanation_id: Setelah 'Could you please' kata kerja berbentuk dasar: 'Could you please send', bukan 'sending'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is the most appropriate way to apologise in a formal letter?
questions.explanation_id: Permintaan maaf formal: 'Please accept my sincere apologies for...'. Pilihan lain adalah bahasa lisan/slang.
options: Please accept my sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused.
Sorry about the mess, my fault!
My bad, it won't happen again.
correct_answers: Please accept my sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused.

questions.prompt: In a formal letter, which verb best replaces 'put off' in: 'The meeting has been put off until next week'?
questions.explanation_id: Put off = menunda -> versi formal 'postponed'. Cancelled = dibatalkan, brought forward = dimajukan.

questions.prompt: Match each phrasal verb with its formal equivalent.
questions.explanation_id: look into = investigate, get in touch with = contact, put up with = tolerate, turn down = reject. Surat formal lebih memilih kata kerja satu kata.

questions.prompt: Rewrite without a contraction for a formal letter: 'I won't be able to attend.' -> I ___ be able to attend.
questions.explanation_id: Surat formal menghindari kontraksi: won't -> will not.

questions.prompt: You are writing to your neighbour, Mrs Clarke, whom you know a little. Which opening is most suitable?
questions.explanation_id: Semi-formal dan nama diketahui: 'Dear Mrs Clarke,'. 'Dear Sir or Madam' dan 'To whom it may concern' untuk penerima tanpa nama.

questions.prompt: Which closing best suits a semi-formal letter to a colleague you call by their first name?
questions.explanation_id: Semi-formal: 'Kind regards,' (atau 'Best wishes,'). 'Yours faithfully' untuk penerima tanpa nama; dua lainnya terlalu akrab.

questions.prompt: Choose TWO sentences that suit an informal letter to a close friend.
questions.explanation_id: Surat informal memakai kontraksi, seruan, dan nada akrab. Tiga lainnya adalah frasa surat formal.
options: Guess what? I've finally got a new job!
I am writing to inform you of my new employment.
Can't wait to see you next month!
I would be obliged if you could reply promptly.
correct_answers: Guess what? I've finally got a new job!
Can't wait to see you next month!

questions.prompt: Click the word that is NOT appropriate in a formal letter.
questions.explanation_id: 'Mate' adalah sapaan akrab dan tidak pantas dalam surat formal; kalimat lainnya sudah formal.

questions.prompt: Complete the formal request: 'I would be ___ if you could send me a copy of the contract.'
questions.explanation_id: Pola permintaan formal: I would be grateful/obliged if you could + V1.

questions.prompt: Which sentence states a complaint most appropriately in a formal letter?
questions.explanation_id: Keluhan formal tetap sopan dan lengkap: 'I was extremely disappointed with...'. Pilihan lain kasar, slang, atau tidak lengkap.
options: I was extremely disappointed with the quality of the meal.
Your restaurant is the worst ever!!!
correct_answers: I was extremely disappointed with the quality of the meal.

questions.prompt: Put the parts in order to make a formal closing sentence.
questions.explanation_id: Pola formal: Should you require ... (= If you need ...), please do not hesitate to contact me.

questions.prompt: Choose the most formal verb to complete: 'I did not ___ your letter of 3 May.'
questions.explanation_id: Receive adalah padanan formal dari 'get' untuk surat/dokumen.

questions.prompt: Match each formal phrase with its purpose.
questions.explanation_id: Please accept my apologies = meminta maaf; complain = mengeluh; I would be grateful if = meminta; enquire = menanyakan informasi.

left: I am writing to complain about...
I would be grateful if you could...
I am writing to enquire about...

questions.prompt: You missed your friend's birthday party. Which apology is most natural in an informal letter?
questions.explanation_id: Kepada teman, permintaan maaf memakai bahasa akrab dan kontraksi. Tiga pilihan lain terlalu kaku.
options: I'm really sorry I couldn't make it to your party!
I wish to offer my formal apologies for my absence.
Please accept our regrets regarding the event.
We regret to inform you that I was absent.
correct_answers: I'm really sorry I couldn't make it to your party!

questions.prompt: Replace 'carry on' with a formal one-word verb: 'Please ___ to use the side entrance until the work is finished.'
questions.explanation_id: Carry on = continue. Struktur 'continue to + V1' cocok dengan kalimat ini.

questions.prompt: Which sentence would sound TOO formal in a letter to a close friend?
questions.explanation_id: 'I hereby acknowledge receipt of...' adalah bahasa dokumen resmi. Tiga lainnya wajar untuk teman.
options: I hereby acknowledge receipt of your letter.
Thanks so much for your letter!
It was lovely to hear from you.
correct_answers: I hereby acknowledge receipt of your letter.
